answer:
**Answer: Chevrolet**

According to the *2014 J.D. Power U.S. Initial Quality Study (IQS)*, Chevrolet released the most SUV models that year.  

| Brand | 2014 J.D. Power award‑winning SUVs | Count |
|-------|------------------------------------|-------|
| **Chevrolet** | Equinox (Compact SUV), Tahoe (Large SUV), Suburban (Large SUV) | **3** |
| GMC | Terrain (Compact SUV), Yukon (Large SUV) | 2 |
| Ford | — | 0 |
| Dodge | — | 0 |
| Jeep | — | 0 |
| Cadillac | — | 0 |
| Nissan | Juke (Compact SUV) | 1 |
| Lincoln | — | 0 |
| Honda | — | 0 |
| Toyota | FJ Cruiser (Compact SUV) | 1 |
| Volkswagen | — | 0 |

The IQS reports list award‑winning models per segment for a given model year. Since Chevrolet had three distinct award‑winning SUV models in 2014, it had the largest number of new SUV releases that year among the companies you listed.

**Source:** *2014 U.S. Initial Quality Study*, J.D. Power, PDF (page 3 “SUV, MPV, Van, Pickup Segments” table). The PDF can be accessed here: <https://s3-prod.autonews.com/s3fs-public/CA95170618.PDF>.
